issues.description: RPC contract silently broadened to ship unbounded script content alongside metadata.
issues.detail: compile_notebook now returns the entire compiled script body in the same response as pipeline_package_path. No size bound, no spec change, and the path already exists on disk. The right shape is a separate file-serving/download endpoint that callers invoke on demand. Strip script_content from the RPC envelope.

issues.description: Entire script body threaded through three layers of React state for a click-time blob.
issues.detail: compiledContent flows through DeploysProgress state, props, and DeployProgress props purely to feed a Blob on click. Storing arbitrary-sized file bodies in a progress widget's state conflates the progress abstraction with file-download mechanics. Extract a download utility and fetch by path at click time.

issues.description: Download button precondition unenforced; handler silently no-ops when content missing.
issues.detail: The icon renders unconditionally in the success branch, but handleDownloadClick guards on both compiledPath and compiledContent and returns silently on failure. Either the guard is dead code or the rendering invariant is wrong. Make compiledContent required in the button's type, or hide the affordance when absent.

issues.description: Script file opened without an explicit encoding.
issues.detail: open(script_path) relies on the platform default encoding, leaking locale behavior through the RPC contract. Specify encoding='utf-8' so the returned string has a stated, portable contract independent of the server's environment.

issues.description: Download icon is a clickable element but not a button or anchor; no keyboard affordance.
issues.detail: GetAppIcon has onClick and titleAccess but is not a <button>, lacks keyboard handlers, and has no focus semantics. The adjacent control is already an anchor; either use <a download> for native browser behavior or a real <button>. The current shape is inconsistent and not keyboard-reachable.

issues.description: Filename derivation uses a fabricated fallback that contradicts the success branch.
issues.detail: fileName = props.compiledPath.split('/').pop() || 'pipeline.kale.py' silently substitutes a name when the path is empty or ends in a slash. Either compiledPath is guaranteed non-empty here (the fallback is dead) or it isn't (the user gets a wrong name). Use a basename helper and one stated case.

synthesis.summary: Consensus: the feature is useful but picks the wrong data shape. The compile_notebook RPC was silently broadened to ship the entire compiled script body alongside its metadata, and that body is then threaded through three layers of React state to feed a click-time Blob — when a separate path-based download endpoint would compose cleanly with the browser's native download. Secondary issues cluster around an unenforced precondition on the download button (silent no-op when content missing), missing UTF-8 encoding on the server-side file read, non-semantic clickable icon without keyboard affordance, and a fabricated filename fallback. Strip script_content from the RPC, add a file-serving route, and let a real anchor or button do the work.
